text: # kimik3-c1-p90-sa: the pinned Kimi K3 weights + DSpark draft + the uncapped 062126 trace corpus into one HF cache on the
# node's NVMe (refs/main = the pins, for offline loads). Adapted from experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/dl.sh.
#   mode hf  (default): a fresh download from the Hub at the exact revisions (Xet high-performance; HF token on the node host
#   mode nfs (fallback): a copy of the same revisions from the shared hub $SHARED_HUB (it has them, verified 2026-11-14),
#                       only the pinned snapshot (the shared Kimi-K3 repo holds 3 snapshots), files dereferenced.
# Either way: every shard the index names must resolve, and every file's size must equal the Hub's (HF API metadata).
# The corpus is always copied from the shared hub (classic layout: campaign 5's fixcorpus.sh found that aiperf's datasets
# cannot read a huggingface_hub-2.4 download offline).
log "start mode=$MODE on $(hostname -s); $NL free ${free_gb} GB (need $NEED_GB); $(df -h --output=source,size,used,avail,pcent "$NL" | tail -1)"
[ $(( free_gb + ${have_gb:-0} )) -ge $NEED_GB ] || die "not enough NVMe space: ${free_gb} GB free + ${have_gb:-0} GB already here < $NEED_GB GB"
[ -x "$PYDL" ] || { python3 -m venv "$NL/dlvenv" && "$NL/dlvenv/bin/pip" -q install huggingface_hub hf_xet; } || die "dl venv"
log "huggingface_hub $($PYDL -c 'import huggingface_hub as h; print(h.__version__)'), token $([ -n "${HF_TOKEN:-}" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
assert info.sha == rev, f"{repo}: Hub says {info.sha} for {rev}"
sizes = {s.rfilename: s.size for s in info.siblings}
s, d = os.path.join(src, name), os.path.join(snap, name)
shutil.copyfile(s, d + ".part"); os.replace(d + ".part", d)   # follows the blob symlink
names = [n for n in sizes if os.path.exists(os.path.join(src, n))]
print(f"[dl] copied {done/1e9:.1f} GB of {repo} from {src}", flush=True)
idx = [f for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")]
want = set(json.load(open(os.path.join(snap, idx[0])))["weight_map"].values()) if idx else {f for f in sizes if f.endswith(".safetensors")}
missing = [f for f in want if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(snap, f))]
bad = [f for f, n in sizes.items() if n is not None and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(snap, f)) and os.path.getsize(os.path.join(snap, f)) != n]
assert not bad, f"{repo}: size differs from the Hub for {bad[:5]}"
absent = [f for f in sizes if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(snap, f))]
gb = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(snap, f)) for f in want) / 1e9
print(f"[dl] ok {repo}@{rev[:10]}: {len(want)} shards resolve, {gb:.1f} GB, sizes = Hub; "
f"{len(absent)} Hub files not present {absent[:3]}; {time.time()-t:.0f} s -> refs/main pinned", flush=True)
# ---- corpus (from the shared hub, classic layout, same revision) ------------------------------------------------------
[ "$(cat "$SHARED_HUB/$C/refs/main")" = "$CORPUS_REV" ] || die "shared hub corpus is not at $CORPUS_REV"
a=$(find -L "$SHARED_HUB/$C/snapshots/$CORPUS_REV" -type f | wc -l); b=$(find -L "$HUB_NL/$C/snapshots/$CORPUS_REV" -type f | wc -l)
# Smoke and before/after measurements for kimik3-c1-p90-sa: full AgentX at C1 and GSM8K, before and after the campaign, on a
# fresh server. Adapted from experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/ab.sh (SGLang) for vLLM. Serves the tree in the container as
# Arbor builds the launch (arbor/frameworks/vllm.py: vllm serve M --served-model-name M --host 0.0.0.0 --port P
# --tensor-parallel-size 8 <server_flags>, with the config's server_env and ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpus>, no
#   1. the server under test (the config as is: CI's synthetic DSpark acceptance): the pack's correctness.sh, then the pack's
#      bench_agentx.sh (the AgentX replay, DURATION s). The DSpark acceptance it really saw is logged too.
#   2. the same tree with REAL acceptance (speculative-config rejection_sample_method block, no synthetic length), as CI's
#      evals run: correctness.sh and GSM8K (InferenceX run_lm_eval, infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml).
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>      e.g.  before 3600 1319 | after 3600 1319 | smoke 600 200
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "[v]llm serve" >/dev/null && die "a vllm server is already running in $CONTAINER"
WS=$("$PY" -c "import json; print(json.load(open('$CONFIG'))['workspace_root'] or '')"); [ -n "$WS" ] || die "workspace_root not resolved (run prepare.sh)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WS log -1 --format='tree %H %s'; git -C $WS status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | head -20" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt"
# THE LAUNCH TO SERVE: once the campaign has started, Arbor keeps the live launch in <workspace_root>/arbor/config.json (every
# KEEP that changes a flag or env edits it). arbor/execute/bench.py: its server_flags win (unless absent/None), its server_env
# is merged over $CONFIG's. The first "after" run built from $CONFIG alone dropped 3 kept changes (2026-11-16). So: the
# workspace config when it exists (AB_CONFIG overrides); the source used is printed and saved.
cfg, outh, gpus, port, dur, outc, launch = sys.argv[1:8]
c["server_env"] = {**{k: str(v) for k, v in c["server_env"].items()}, **{k: str(v) for k, v in (w.get("server_env") or {}).items()}}
print(f"[ab] launch from {launch or cfg + ' (no workspace arbor/config.json yet: pre-campaign)'}")
env = {k: v for k, v in c["server_env"].items() if not k.startswith("_")}
for k, v in env.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(str(v))}\n")
names = c["model_name"] if c["model_path"] in ("", c["model_name"]) else f"{c['model_name']} {c['model_path']}"
# the real-acceptance variant: only the speculative config changes (block rejection, no synthetic length)
for name, flags in (("serve.sh", c["server_flags"]), ("serve_real.sh", " ".join(shlex.quote(t) for t in real))):
log "$TAG: tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); server on GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX ${DUR}s; GSM8K $NQ"
log "$TAG: page cache before start: $(free -g | awk '/Mem:/ {print $6" GB buff/cache"}')"
for i in $(seq 1 480); do   # up to 2 h (VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S is 7200)
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "[v]llm serve .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL $1 died after $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) s"; tail -40 "$OUT_H/$2"; exit 1; }
[ $(( i % 20 )) -eq 0 ] && log "$TAG: starting, $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) s: $(tail -1 "$OUT_H/$2" | tr '\r' '\n' | tail -1 | cut -c1-150)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL $1 not healthy after 2 h"; tail -20 "$OUT_H/$2"; exit 1; }
log "$TAG: $1 healthy after $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) s (server start time)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "pid=\$(pgrep -f '[v]llm serve .*--port $PORT ' | head -1); [ -n \"\$pid\" ] && kill -TERM -- -\$(ps -o pgid= -p \$pid | tr -d ' ') 2>/dev/null; \
for i in \$(seq 1 24); do pgrep -f '[v]llm serve|[V]LLM::' >/dev/null || break; sleep 5; done; pkill -TERM -f '[V]LLM::'; sleep 15; true"
log "$TAG: server stopped; GPU VRAM%: $(rocm-smi --showmemuse 2>/dev/null | awk '/VRAM%/ {printf "%s ", $NF}')"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_ID CORRECTNESS_OUTPUT=$OUT_C/$1.json bash /workspace/Arbor/packs/$PACK/validator/correctness.sh" > "$OUT_H/$1.log" 2>&1
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c ". $OUT_C/server.env; export PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_ID MODEL_NAME=$MODEL_ID CONCURRENCY=1 NUM_PROMPTS=320 \
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s: $(grep -a '^\[bench_agentx\] p90_intvty' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
grep -a "SpecDecoding metrics" "$OUT_H/server.log" | sed 's/.*Mean acceptance length: \([0-9.]*\).*/\1/' | sort -n \
| awk -v t="$TAG" '{a[NR]=$1} END{if (NR) printf "[ab] %s: DSpark mean acceptance length over %d windows: min %s, median %s, max %s\n", t, NR, a[1], a[int(NR/2)+1], a[NR]}'
# ---- 2. the same tree with real acceptance: correctness + GSM8K ---------------------------------------------------
&& run_lm_eval --port $PORT --task /workspace/InferenceX/infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml --results-dir $OUT_C/gsm8k'" > "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" 2>&1   # timeout cannot run a shell function
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ, real acceptance) rc=$rc after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s"
if not fs: sys.exit("[ab] gsm8k: no results json")
print(f"[ab] gsm8k {task}: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v:.4f}" for k, v in m.items() if isinstance(v, float)) + f" (n={r.get('n-samples', {}).get(task)})")
# Provision the node for kimik3-c1-p90-sa. Idempotent; run on the GPU node through ctrl/. Adapted from
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, other users' containers listed (never touched), disk
#   2. the CI image BY DIGEST (its tag is deleted upstream; anonymous pull), tagged locally, digest verified
#   3. Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test from the archive (plain tree + a local git commit), the local prompt fixes, pack, config
#   5. the HF cache on NVMe: model, draft and corpus at their pins (dl.sh), every shard resolving
#   6. the container: the NVMe hub at /hf-hub, InferenceX (read-only), Arbor, sessions, the experiment
#   7. stack versions; vllm's package dir as workspace_root (a git repo, committed as shipped); aiter/flydsl paths; the image
#      must carry the latency_specialized decode (vllm#60683) the c1 point needs
#   8. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX's install_agentic_deps) and lm-eval for GSM8K (pip diff logged)
#   9. ruppell for the profiler skill (not fatal)
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$CONTAINER" 2>/dev/null)" = true ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"

log "disk: NVMe $(df -h --output=avail "$NL" | tail -1 | tr -d ' ') free; docker root $(docker info -f '{{.DockerRootDir}}') $(df -h --output=avail "$(docker info -f '{{.DockerRootDir}}')" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -d ' ') free; RAM $(free -g | awk '/Mem:/ {print $2" GB total, "$7" GB available"}')"
log "pulling $IMAGE_REPO@$IMAGE_DIGEST (tag is deleted upstream; by digest)"
DOCKER_CONFIG=$EXP/.docker_anon docker pull -q "$IMAGE_REPO@$IMAGE_DIGEST" || die "image pull by digest FAILED: do not substitute another image; report"
*"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST ($(docker image inspect -f '{{.Size}}' "$IMAGE_TAG" | awk '{printf "%.1f GB", $1/1e9}'))";;
git -C "$ARBOR" init -q && git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh add -A \
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -m "AMD-AGI/Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test $ARBOR_SHA (archive)" || die "Arbor git"
# Local prompt fixes (harness only): every Monitor wait the agents are told to use prints a heartbeat (the CLI ends a Monitor
# silent for 10 min; a K3 server start and a 3600 s bench both run longer). Campaign 5 fixed the bench prompt only.
if ! git -C "$ARBOR" log --format=%s | grep -q "Monitor heartbeat"; then
git -C "$ARBOR" apply --check "$EXP/stage/arbor_local_fixes.patch" || die "local fix patch does not apply"
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -qam "local fix: Monitor heartbeat in the server and bench waits (the CLI ends a Monitor silent for 10 min)" \
&& mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG")" && cp "$EXP/stage/config.json" "$CONFIG" || die "pack/config"   # step 7 resolves it
python3 -m venv "$VENV" && "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && "$PY" -m pip install -q pyyaml claude-agent-sdk || die "venv"
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
# aiperf's subprocesses do not always see HF_HUB_CACHE (Kimi K3.1 Pro, 2026-11-13): point the default cache at the hub too.
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'mkdir -p /root/.cache/huggingface && ln -sfn /hf-hub /root/.cache/huggingface/hub' || die "hub symlink"
python3 -c "import vllm, torch; print(\"vllm:\", vllm.__version__, vllm.__file__); print(\"torch:\", torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
WS=$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c "import os, vllm; print(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__))" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
[ "$n_ls" -gt 0 ] || die "the image's vllm has no latency_specialized decode (vllm#60683): not the CI image?"
log "vllm at $WS; latency_specialized found in $n_ls files"
# Arbor's has_changes needs the workspace to be a git repo (a pip-installed vllm is not: Kimi K3.1 Pro, 2026-11-13). Commit it
# as shipped, so Arbor's diffs start from the image's code.
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd $WS && { git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || git init -q .; } \
&& { git config user.email >/dev/null || { git config user.email arbor@local; git config user.name Arbor; }; } \
&& { [ -z \"\$(git status --porcelain)\" ] || { git add -A && git commit -q -m 'baseline: vllm as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG@$IMAGE_DIGEST'; }; }" \
log "workspace $WS at $(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C "$WS" log -1 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-90)"
p, c, ws = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
pk = [e for e in cfg.get("editable_packages", []) if e.get("name") not in ("aiter", "flydsl")]
path = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip() else ""
# (Editable packages need no git: arbor/execute/packages.py compares their .py digests against the image.)
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"
# The bench loads the corpus hub-offline: `datasets` must have prepared it once (smoke 2026-11-14: OfflineModeIsEnabled).
[ "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -eq 0 ] || die "corpus not loadable offline by aiperf"

source /workspace/InferenceX/benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh && _install_lm_eval_deps && _patch_lm_eval && python3 -c "import lm_eval; print(\"lm_eval\", lm_eval.__version__)"' 2>&1 | tail -1 | sed 's/^/[prepare] /'
[ -z "$changed" ] && log "lm-eval install changed no pre-existing package" || log "WARNING lm-eval install changed pre-existing packages: $(echo "$changed" | tr '\n' ' ')"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c "import vllm" || die "vllm no longer imports after the lm-eval install"
&& log "InferenceX clean at ${INFX_SHA:0:10}" || log "WARNING InferenceX tree: $(git -C "$INFX" rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
